task_description: Implement the remaining READ/LIST/DETAIL frontend screens for the Aurinara Clinical Artifact Platform React app per the APPROVED design.md: a current-study context + header study switcher, reusable ResourceTable/PageHeader/state components, three new shadcn primitives (table/select/tabs), and bindings for all 12 module routes (raw, documents, sdtm, adam, tlf, standards, terminology, validation, reconciliation, review, packaging, integrations).
